meta.name: google-workspace-automation
meta.description: Design Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Calendar automations with scope-aware plans. Use for repeatable daily task automation with explicit OAuth scopes and audit-ready outputs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行 Gmail、云端硬盘、表格和日历的重复任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天花大量时间在 Google 办公套件中做重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate repetitive tasks across Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Calendar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spend hours on repetitive tasks in Google Workspace daily

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你设计 Gmail、Google 云端硬盘、表格和日历的自动化方案，包括定义目标、所需权限、执行计划，并输出可审计的文档。
howto.when: 当你需要重复执行日常办公任务（如自动整理邮件、同步表格数据、管理日历事件）时，可以要求 Claude 设计自动化方案。

say.text: 帮我设计一个自动归档 Gmail 收件箱的流程。
say.note: Claude 会规划步骤、权限和定时执行方案。

say.text: 我想让 Google 表格每天自动汇总销售数据。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含 OAuth 范围和重试逻辑的计划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design automation plans for Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Calendar, including defining goals, required OAuth scopes, execution schedules, and producing auditable artifacts.
howto.when_en: When you need to automate repeatable daily tasks such as organizing emails, syncing spreadsheet data, or managing calendar events, you can ask Claude to design an automation plan.

say_en.text: Design an automation to archive old emails in Gmail.
say_en.note: Claude will outline steps, scopes, and a schedule.

say_en.text: Create a daily summary of sales data in Google Sheets.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a plan with retry behavior and audit output.
